verses.1:
A Psalm of David.
 The LORD is my shepherd; + 23:1 See Revelation 7:17|REV 7:17 . 
 I shall not want.
verses.2:
He makes me lie down in green pastures;
 He leads me beside quiet waters.
verses.4:
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, + 23:4 Or the valley of deep darkness 
 I will fear no evil,
 for You are with me;
 Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.5:
You prepare a table before me
 in the presence of my enemies.
 You anoint my head with oil;
 my cup overflows.
verses.6:
Surely goodness and mercy will follow me
 all the days of my life,
 and I will dwell in the house of the LORD
 forever. + 23:6 Literally for a length of days

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
